author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.40 shipped: HVAC W1-C P2: ecobee (HomeKit) thin adapter
summary: HVAC W1-C P2: ecobee (HomeKit) thin adapter
why: The second home runs three ecobee thermostats over HomeKit, and URA's thermostat layer only knew Carrier/Bryant, gating everything else off by brand against the operator's thin-adapter rule. This adds an ecobee adapter so every HVAC feature works the same on both brands: URA holds each preset's range (min gap from the installer setting, measured 5 F on site), reads presets through the adapter so wall changes read as manual, and keeps Carrier writes byte-identical. Four reviews plus a fix pass found and closed an x.5/min-gap original-capture leak, corrupt-store handling and arrester reference drift.
implications: Shipped HVAC-W1C-GENERIC-THERMOSTAT-1 at v5.103.40; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.40.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Any ecobee range write narrower than the configured gap, any Carrier climate_write change after deploy, or option C (comfort-setting select) landing

refs.release_notes: Ecobee HomeKit thermostats get a thin command adapter (range holds with configurable 5-10 F min gap, whole-degree rounding, heat_cool precondition, preset reads via adapter, CPR on ecobee). feature_available removed. Carrier byte-identical. Option C follow-up planned.
